text:
maya: Quick sync — can we schedule a 30m readout for the latency + cost benchmark results from this sprint? Goal: decide model quant/route to roll to staging. Proposed slots: Tue 10:00-10:30, Wed 15:00-15:30, Thu 09:00-09:30. Draft agenda:
1) benchmark summary (p50/p95/p99, cost/token)
2) regressions and root causes
3) quantization experiments + perf tradeoffs
4) caching / KV warmup observations
5) rollout plan + canary thresholds
6) action items
Dashboards: https://dash.re/redwood/infer/latency-cost?range=last_7d
Artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/runs/2026-03-15/latest/
Please ping availability and any add-ons to the agenda. :calendar:

sam: Tue 10 works for me. Wed I have an all-hands. Quick ask — can we add a short slot for cost-per-inference breakdown by routing policy? I'll bring numbers. Also will post perf diffs for int8 vs fp16.

jordan: I'm out Tue morning. Wed 15:00 is borderline but might work if earlier meetings finish. Thu 09:00 would be ideal for me. Can we include cache hit-rate / cold KV warmup in the agenda? I think that's causing a p99 spike in some flows.

lee: Thu 09:00 nominally good, but I'll need to prep rollout checklist and signoff thresholds. Adding 'fallback model mapping' as an agenda item (so product can confirm correctness).

toni: Heads up — infra maintenance scheduled Thu 09:00-10:00 UTC in us-east-1. That may affect dedicated pools and any live runs. If maintenance is real, Thu slot is bad. Can we avoid that window? I'll confirm with infra and post details.

maya: Good catch @toni — let's avoid Thu then. New poll: Tue 10 or Wed 15. If we pick Tue 10 we can do a quick pre-run Monday evening to populate KV caches.

deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance in us-east-1 on 2026-03-18 09:00-10:00 UTC (impact: inference running on dedicated pools).

sam: Ok, Tue 10 confirmed from my side. I'll add perf diff (int8 vs fp16) and include cost/token estimates + token-level breakdown.

jordan: Wed 15 still preferred for me, but I can reorder to make Tue 10 if that's consensus. If we go Tue, can someone run the p99 + cost query against latest run and paste numbers here?

maya: Let's lock Tue 10 then — seems like majority. Action items: maya -> send calendar invite (30m), sam -> perf diffs and cost breakdown, jordan -> cache hit analysis + KV warmup numbers, lee -> rollout checklist + canary thresholds, toni -> confirm maintenance impact and any mitigation.

maya: Also: please drop 2-slide callout + top 3 findings in this thread before EOD Monday. If you have PRs or run artifacts, paste links here. :eyes:

maya: Sending invite now: https://calendar.redwood.com/event?eid=abc123 (attach slides to event)

sam: Posted perf diffs gist: https://gist.github.com/sam/perf-int8-vs-fp16 — will also attach CSV to calendar.

jordan: I'll post cache hit heatmap before EOD and include the query I used:
```sql
SELECT model, percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p99, avg(cost_per_request) AS avg_cost
FROM inference_runs
WHERE run_id = '2026-03-15-latest'
GROUP BY model;
```

toni: Confirmed maintenance scope: only us-east-1 dedicated pools, ephemeral impact during 09:00-09:20. I'll work with infra to ensure dedicated tests for Tue aren't blocked.

maya: Thanks everyone — see you Tue 10. If anything changes, post here and I'll re-run the poll. :thumbsup:
